name: shovel
description: Shovel is a study planner for college students. Connect your Shovel account to see what to work on next, add work from a syllabus, build your weekly schedule and plan your study time.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and track your study time
interface.longDescription:
Shovel is a study planner for college students. It shows how much free time you have before each deadline and plans your study sessions around your classes, work and the rest of your life.

Connect your Shovel account to:
- Ask what to work on next, based on your deadlines and how much free time is left before each one
- Add assignments, readings and exams from a syllabus, PDF or list, with due dates and time estimates
- Build your weekly schedule: classes, activities and other regular commitments
- Plan your week in one message: Shovel's Auto-plan puts your study sessions on your calendar
- Move or remove study sessions, log time you studied and run a study timer
- See your calendar and your progress

When you connect, you choose whether ChatGPT can only view your Shovel or also make changes. Changes show up in Shovel right away, and most deleted items can be restored for 30 days in Shovel (Settings, AI assistants).

Requires a Shovel account.
defaultPrompt: What should I work on tonight and why?
Plan my study time for the next 7 days

positive.description: Suggests what to study next from the student's deadlines
positive.prompt: What should I work on tonight and why?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the student's Shovel overview and tasks, then names one or two specific tasks (with their course and due date) to work on first, picking overdue work and the nearest deadlines with the least free time left, and says why.

positive.description: Adds one assignment to a course
positive.prompt: Add a Biology 101 lab report due next Friday at 11:59 pm. It should take about 3 hours.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Biology 101 course, may confirm the details first, then adds one task due next Friday at 11:59 pm with a 3-hour estimate and confirms it was added. The task appears in Shovel.

positive.description: Plans the coming week with Shovel's Auto-plan
positive.prompt: Plan my study time for the next 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs Shovel's Auto-plan, after ChatGPT's own approval prompt if one appears, and puts study sessions on the Shovel calendar. It then says which tasks landed on which days and times and anything that won't fit. The sessions appear in Shovel.
Lists tomorrow's classes, events and planned study sessions in time order, in the student's own time zone.

positive.description: Logs study time the student already did
positive.prompt: I just studied for my History 210 midterm for 45 minutes. Log it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the History 210 midterm task, logs 45 minutes of study ending now and confirms the time now counts toward that task.

negative.description: General knowledge question with nothing to do with the student's planner

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn leaves.

negative.description: Travel booking, which Shovel doesn't do
negative.prompt: Find me a cheap flight from Boston to Chicago next weekend.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
